note: EXPLICIT, fail-closed deploy allowlist for the G1 sealed-VM bundle. A bundle-relative path is permitted to transfer to the VM iff it matches an `allow` glob AND matches NO `deny` glob. Enforcement is PRE-TRANSFER: src/allowlist.ts (assertDeployable / checkBundle) is the pure enforcer, and deploy/seal.sh re-checks this file and refuses to arm if any key-material path is present in the staged bundle. Unknown paths are DENIED by default (no allow match).

glob.**: matches any run of characters including '/'
glob.**/: matches zero or more leading path segments
glob.*: matches any run of characters except '/'

denyRationale: Every private key / secret-material shape is excluded so no SSH key, signing key, PEM, dotenv, or any *secret* file can ride into a bundle that is explicitly built to hold NO authority and NO production memory. `deny` wins over `allow`: a path under an allowed directory (e.g. deploy/authority-node.key) is still refused. This list is a coarse structural net; content-level secret detection is D6 textHasSecret, applied by the controller to genome fields, not here.
